title: Non-authoritative numeric-key mobile JSON projection of cord.origin.host/2
description: CBOR byte strings are unpadded base64url. U16/U32/U64 values are decimal strings. Enum values use stable registry names with x-cord-cbor-discriminants. NFC and decoded-byte x-cord-* bounds MUST be enforced before canonical CBOR authorization. Numeric JSON object keys map to unsigned CBOR integer keys.
